Tool 03 · Tiled poster maker

Print a poster on multiple pages.

Split one image across a grid of A4 or Letter sheets. Add optional overlap and cut marks, check the numbered previews, then download your poster PDF.

1 Choose images · 2 Edit and set sizes · 3 Preview and download PDF

1. Images

Choose Edit image to crop, rotate or change pixel dimensions.

Supported files and limits

JPG, PNG and WebP. Up to 30 images, 20 MiB per file and 12 megapixels per image. Total originals and edits: 32 megapixels and 80 MiB. Decoded pixels alone may use 128 MB, plus preview and export memory. Maximum 30 PDF pages.

    2. Size and layout

    Assemble from the top left. Overlap repeats a strip of the image to help align the sheets.

    Paper and margins
    Device preferences

    Images and edits are not kept after closing the page.

    3. Preview and download

    Print at 100% or Actual size to keep the dimensions. 10 cm ruler test

    Short guide and examples

    How do I choose poster size?

    Columns and rows set the number of sheets. The finished image area appears above the preview, accounting for margins and overlap. Keep the entire image with Fit or fill the area with Crop.

    Why add overlap?

    Overlap repeats a strip on neighboring sheets for alignment and gluing. Trim one edge at each join and leave the other underneath. Assemble from the top left.

    Quick example

    A 2 × 2 portrait A4 grid with 10 mm margins and 5 mm overlap gives a 375 × 549 mm image area. Choose a high-resolution original; enlargement adds no detail.
